abstract: The purpose of this cross-sectional study was to determine the correlation of beta subunit human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-hCG) level in the serum and first morning urine samples of patients with gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD). A total of 81 paired serum and first morning urine samples from 24 patients diagnosed with GTD, who had their follow-up at the Division of Gynecologic Oncology, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Faculty of Medicine Siriraj Hospital, Mahidol University. The paired serum and first morning urine samples were measured for beta-hCG level, using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). After logarithmic transformation, serum beta-hCG level was strongly and significantly correlated to those of first morning urine samples, with the correlation coefficient of 0.97 (p < 0.01). Among the disease-remission group (serum beta-hCG of less than 5 mIU/ml), the correlation coefficient was 0.52 (p < 0.01), which was still statistically significant. Stronger statistical significance was found in the disease-active group (serum beta-hCG of 5 mIU/ml or higher), with the correlation coefficient of 0.95 (p < 0.01). We concluded that the level of serum beta-hCG was strongly and significantly correlated with those of first morning urine samples, especially in patients with active disease. Determination of beta-hCG level using first morning urine samples can be used as an effective mean in the follow-up of patients with GTD.
abstract_ja: 本横断研究の目的は、妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）患者の血清および早朝尿中のβ-サブユニットヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン（β-hCG）値の相関を明らかにすることであった。妊娠性絨毛性疾患と診断され、マヒドン大学医学部シリラート病院産婦人科 婦人科腫瘍部門でフォローアップを受けた24例の患者から、計81組の血清と早朝尿の検体を採取した。対になった血清と早朝尿の検体について、酵素結合免疫吸着測定法（ELISA）でβ-hCG値を測定した。対数変換後、血清β-hCG値は早朝尿の値と強く有意に相関し、相関係数は0.97（p<0.01）であった。寛解群（血清β-hCGが5 mIU/ml未満）では相関係数0.52（p<0.01）で、それでも統計学的に有意であった。活動性疾患群（血清β-hCGが5 mIU/ml以上）ではより強い有意性が認められ、相関係数は0.95（p<0.01）であった。血清β-hCG値は、特に活動性疾患の患者において、早朝尿の値と強く有意に相関すると結論した。早朝尿を用いたβ-hCG値の測定は、GTD患者のフォローアップにおける有効な手段として用いることができる。
